test_version_numbers: test the TestVersions.test_version_numbers method to verify game version numbers match expected build and data versions
test_versions_create_game: test the TestVersions.test_versions_create_game method to create a game and step through initial observations on each supported version
run_get_versions: run run_configs.get().get_versions() to retrieve a dictionary of all supported StarCraft II game versions
run_config_start: run run_configs.get(version=game_version).start() to launch a controller connection for a specific game version
controller_ping: run controller.ping() to check the running StarCraft II build version, game version, and data version
